answer: Anchor each agent identity to a cedar-like stake: a refundable deposit locked in a slow-release escrow, plus a verifiable history of useful work. New accounts start with a weak pulse of trust and gain attestation only after peers confirm real contributions. A reef of independent validators cross-checks behavior, so a Sybil farm must fund many deposits, sustain many fake histories, and survive cross-validation — the cost of forging a thousand identities exceeds any reward from one.
